title: Staff Software Engineer (Marketing Platforms)
description:
Empresa está contratando Staff Software Engineer (Marketing Platforms) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role The Marketing Platforms  area, inside our Growth Platforms BU , is responsible for enabling Nubank’s growth engine across owned and paid channels. This includes our public websites (BR, MX, CO and future markets), the Audience Manager  platform (how we build, govern and activate audiences for campaigns and experiments), and Campaign Manager / orchestration  capabilities that connect messages, audiences and channels into coherent customer journeys at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer – Marketing Platforms , you will be a senior technical leader working across this ecosystem: defining architecture and technical direction, ensuring that Audience Manager, Website Platform and Campaign Manager evolve as a cohesive platform, and directly influencing how Nubank acquires, engages and retains customers across countries. You’ll be responsible for Designing and evolving large-scale, data-intensive marketing platforms, in domains such as martech, experimentation, audience/identity and web platforms, operating across multiple channels and markets. Working end-to-end across the Marketing Platforms stack, partnering with Audience Manager, Website Platform and Campaign Manager squads to define technical direction, shape roadmaps and ensure these platforms work together as a cohesive ecosystem. Translating growth and brand strategy into platform architecture, turning audience, campaign and website needs into clear architectural choices and explicit trade-offs with a long-term view. Providing strong technical leadership: setting architectural direction, leading design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring engineers and tech leads across multiple squads. Helping teams design systems that are observable, debuggable and experimentation-friendly, supporting data-driven decision making in how we run campaigns and optimize journeys. Navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities, manage dependencies and keep interfaces between systems healthy over time. Operating in high-visibility, cross-impact areas, where platform decisions directly affect Nubank’s growth, brand presence and audience activation across BR, MX, CO and future geos. Framing ambiguous problems into clear options, and driving alignment through well-structured communication (technical docs, RFCs, design sessions and presentations).  We are looking for a person who has Required Solid experience as a Staff-level engineer designing and evolving large-scale, data-intensive platforms, ideally in marketing technology, experimentation, audience/identity or web platforms. Ability to work end-to-end across a multi-product stack, partnering with several squads to make sure platforms interoperate as a coherent ecosystem. Proven track record connecting product strategy and platform design, turning growth and brand objectives into concrete architectural choices for audiences, campaign orchestration and website capabilities. Strong technical leadership skills: setting architectural direction, driving design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers and tech leaders. Experience with experimentation and data-driven decision making, and with designing systems that are observable, instrumented and easy to reason about. Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, collaborating with Product, Data, Design, Marketing and other platform teams to align priorities and manage dependencies. Comfort operating in high-visibility, cross-impact domains, where platform decisions have direct effect on growth and brand outcomes. High tolerance for ambiguity, with the ability to frame complex problems into clear options and drive alignment through structured written and verbal communication.  Nice to have Background in growth, martech or CRM platforms. Experience in multi-country or multi-brand environments. Previous work on customer data platforms, journey orchestration or experimentation platforms.  Location for this opportunity Brazil – Hybrid hubs: São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte (aligned with Nubank’s official office locations).  Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2–3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit   Our Benefits – Brazil (Employee, Hybrid) Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food / Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale-Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable  Join us If you want to shape the platforms that power Nubank’s growth engine — from how we build audiences to how we orchestrate campaigns and run our public websites — we’d love to hear from you. Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistou em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.  Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.  Alem disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.  A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.  Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.  #vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Prestar assistência de enfermagem durante exames diagnósticos, conforme habilitação profissional.  Organizar salas e materiais, garantindo reposição, controle de validade e funcionamento adequado. description:

About Nu Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. About The Role The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow. As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale. You’ll be responsible for Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations. Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle. Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling. Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect. Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products. Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations. Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI-assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI-first security engineering looks like. Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team.  We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must have Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response). Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security-by-design reviews. Hands-on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off-the-shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine). Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert-level depth not required, but real familiarity is). Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them. Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). Fluency with AI-assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically. Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture. Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem-solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non-technical audiences.  Nice to have Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts. Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols. Experience integrating with third-party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar). Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context. Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs. Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional.  Location for this opportunity São Paulo, Brazil Campinas, Brazil Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Belo Horizonte, Brazil  Our Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable  Work Model for this Role Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. We’re in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it’s not just another day at the (virtual) office, you’re helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.  You’re pushing ahead in your career? Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e acolhedora, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões de higiene e segurança. Acompanhar os tutores até as salas de espera adequadas a fim de garantir o melhor conforto tanto para o tutor quanto para o pet. Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas adicionais, conforme necessário. Ter excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade para lidar com uma variedade de situações e personalidades. Possuir fortes capacidades de organização e gerenciamento de tempo, com atenção aos detalhes. Ser apaixonado por animais e possuir a compreensão dos desafios associados ao cuidado veterinário. Ter atitudes proativas, positivas e colaborativas, com habilidades para trabalhar em equipe.  Benefícios  Oportunidade de integrar em uma equipe comprometida com o bem-estar de todos que entram em nosso espaço e procuram nossos serviços. Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo. Possibilidade de crescimento profissional em um centro de diagnósticos em expansão. Participação constante em treinamentos e reuniões que elevem o desenvolvimento pessoal e da equipe como um todo, permitindo a busca permanente por melhorias. É o setor da empresa que mais tem contato com animais, então, possibilitará estar mais próximo de nossos pet pacientes.  Se você é um profissonal dedicado e entusiasmado, apaixonado por animais, comunicativo e carismático, esta é uma excelente oportunidade pra você! Junte-se a nós e faça parte desta equipe comprometida e dedicada em fornecer a melhor experiência para nossos clientes e pacientes, desde o agendamento do exame até o momento em que nos despedimos e dizemos até logo! description:

Responsabilidades e Atribuições Prestar assistência de enfermagem domiciliar, executando os cuidados prescritos pelo Enfermeiro Coordenador com segurança técnica e respeito à rotina e privacidade familiar. Administrar medicamentos nas vias prescritas (oral, intramuscular, subcutânea, intravenosa) com rigorosa observância dos 9 certos, registrando horários e intercorrências no prontuário. Verificar e registrar sinais vitais (PA, FC, FR, temperatura, SpO2 e escala de dor), comunicando ao Enfermeiro Coordenador qualquer alteração em até 30 minutos. Realizar higiene oral, banho no leito ou assistido, mudança de decúbito e posicionamento funcional, prevenindo lesões por pressão com base na escala de Braden. Executar curativos simples e complexos, cuidados com estomias (colostomia, ileostomia, urostomia), úlceras por pressão e feridas crônicas, conforme protocolo do serviço. Manter e monitorar dispositivos invasivos no domicílio: sonda nasoenteral e nasogástrica, cateter urinário de demora, cateter venoso central e PICC — realizando curativos, verificando permeabilidade e comunicando intercorrências. Realizar aspiração de vias aéreas superiores e de cânula de traqueostomia com técnica asséptica, monitorando SpO2 antes, durante e após o procedimento. Operar e monitorar equipamentos do domicílio: concentrador de oxigênio, aspirador de secreção elétrico, bomba de infusão, ventilador domiciliar, oxímetro de pulso e cama hospitalar articulada. Identificar e comunicar ao Enfermeiro falhas de funcionamento, alarmes persistentes ou necessidade de manutenção de qualquer equipamento instalado no domicílio. Treinar e orientar o cuidador familiar nas atividades de suporte ao cuidado: higiene, posicionamento, oferta de alimentação via sonda, identificação de sinais de alerta e uso correto dos equipamentos. Avaliar a capacidade do cuidador para executar as orientações recebidas, reportando ao Enfermeiro situações de sobrecarga do cuidador ou dificuldade de adesão. Identificar e comunicar situações de risco no ambiente domiciliar: condições de queda, deterioração clínica inesperada, condições insalubres ou sinais de negligência ao paciente. Registrar com precisão todos os procedimentos realizados, intercorrências e a evolução do paciente no prontuário do serviço — físico ou via aplicativo mobile — no dia da visita. Zelar pela organização e controle dos materiais e insumos no domicílio, comunicando necessidades de reposição ao coordenador dentro do prazo estabelecido, sem permitir ruptura de estoque. Cumprir rigorosamente os horários de visita estabelecidos no plano de cuidados, comunicando antecipadamente qualquer impossibilidade de comparecimento à coordenação. Conduzir o atendimento com postura ética e sigilo absoluto, respeitando a privacidade do paciente e da família no ambiente doméstico em todas as circunstâncias.  Requisitos Obrigatórios Curso Técnico em Enfermagem concluído COREN ativo. Experiência comprovada em Home Care, assistência domiciliar, internação domiciliar (ID) ou cuidados de pacientes crônicos complexos. Vacinação completa conforme NR-32: Hepatite B, Tríplice Viral, dTpa, Varicela, Influenza e COVID-19. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala que inclua finais de semana e feriados, conforme o plano de cuidados do paciente.  Requisitos Desejáveis - Diferencial Experiência com pacientes em cuidados paliativos domiciliares — oncológicos, neurológicos (ELA, AVC sequelado, demência avançada) ou cardiorrespiratórios (DPOC grave, IC refratária). Habilidade comprovada na operação de equipamentos domiciliares: concentrador de oxigênio, aspirador de secreção, bomba de infusão e ventilador domiciliar. Experiência em cuidados com traqueostomia, PICC, cateter venoso central e curativos complexos no ambiente domiciliar. Curso de atualização em curativos avançados, estomias, cuidados paliativos ou terapia infusional domiciliar. Familiaridade com prontuário eletrônico mobile (aplicativo de registro em campo) e uso de tablet ou smartphone para documentação clínica. CNH categoria B válida — valorizado em regiões onde o deslocamento entre domicílios é realizado de forma autônoma pelo profissional.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.  Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.  Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.  A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.  Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.  #vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Ser padrinho de todos os novos Enfermeiros com atuação na assistência;  Acompanhar e gerir o programa de padrinhos, garantindo acolhimento, integração e acompanhamento nos primeiros 90 dias;  Acompanhar e atualizar desempenho dos padrinhos;  Garantir e acompanhar o preenchimento do checklist de 90 dias dos novos colaboradores;  Realizar interface entre padrinhos, RH e novos colaboradores;  Liderar (junto ao gestor) o novo colaborador a assumir paciente integral;  Atuar com os protocolos de segurança (6 metas);  Atividades afins. Aqui na Alea , estamos revolucionando a forma de morar no Brasil. Nascemos do grupo Construtora Tenda , com a missão de construir casas além dos sonhos, ao alcance de todos e em qualquer lugar. Com apenas quatro anos de operação e quase 800 colaboradores, já alcançamos resultados que nos enchem de orgulho. Nossa fábrica, em Jaguariúna (SP) , tem capacidade para produzir até 10 mil casas por ano  — e já ultrapassamos a marca de 4 mil casas produzidas . Utilizamos a tecnologia wood frame , um sistema construtivo com estrutura em madeira, amplamente utilizado em países como Estados Unidos, Japão e diversos países da Europa. Essa inovação permite construir com mais agilidade , menos desperdício  e maior controle de qualidade , aliando sustentabilidade e eficiência a cada projeto. Além da fábrica em Jaguariúna, contamos com mais de 20 canteiros de obras  espalhados por diversas cidades do interior de São Paulo, impulsionando o nosso crescimento e consolidando nossa posição como referência em casas industrializadas no Brasil . Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão tornam nosso time mais forte. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a profissionais com deficiência (PcD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente plural, respeitoso e colaborativo. Trabalhar na Alea é fazer parte de uma empresa que constrói o futuro — o das pessoas e o seu também.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product & Marketing Specialist, Latam
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Product & Marketing Specialist, Latam em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  We are a team of passionate individuals, developing ground-breaking biological technologies designed to sustainably, and safely, control insects that transmit diseases and destroy crops. We do this work to improve lives and livelihoods around the world in the face of the growing threats that insects pose to human health and the global food supply.  We are strongly committed to a set of values, principles, and behaviours, which foster a culture of trust, respect, creativity, and accountability - and seek talented people who are deeply committed to our mission, values and principles, and thrive in start-up like environments.  Whilst what we do relates to developing insect control technologies, Oxitec is about people and is in service to people. See here to learn more, and to read more about our mission and vision.  Purpose of the Job  You will help transform advanced biotechnology and AI capabilities into scalable, market-ready solutions deployed across public health and agricultural markets in Brazil and Latin America. Supporting the product lifecycle—from product definition and pricing to go-to-market execution, channel development, and market expansion—you will help ensure that innovations such as Aedes do Bem, predictive AI platforms, and biological pest‑control and monitoring solutions translate into measurable real‑world impact.  You will connect strategy, science, and commercialization to accelerate adoption across markets and channels, helping customers such as municipalities, public‑health programs, private companies, agricultural producers, and distribution partners deploy these solutions effectively at scale. Your work will shape how products are positioned, priced, launched, and backed by clear communication materials to be expanded across the region, contributing to sustainable growth. The impact of your role will be evident in successful product launches, scalable deployment models, strong market intelligence that informs strategic decisions, and the expansion of innovative technologies that improve public health outcomes and agricultural productivity throughout Latin America.  Responsibilities  1. Product support & lifecycle   Support the commercial strategy for your product portfolio, helping shape positioning, target segments, value propositions, and lifecycle activity from launch through growth.  Help maintain a clear view of the product roadmap and priorities, working closely with technical, R&D, and regulatory teams to keep commercial needs aligned with what we build.  Contribute to product requirements and commercial rationale by gathering and synthesizing customer needs, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and regulatory context.  Act as a commercial voice in product discussions, bringing the customer and market perspective into the room.    2. Market & customer intelligence   Build and maintain evidence-based understanding of customers, segments, competitors, pricing, and market trends across the Latam regions we serve.  Turn insight into practical input for positioning, prioritization, and go-to-market decisions, grounded in data.  Monitor competitive and regulatory developments and their commercial implications, and keep the team informed.    3. Go-to-market & launches   Coordinate product launches: launch planning, narrative, value messaging, pricing and positioning inputs, channel readiness, sales enablement, and post-launch tracking.  Help build go-to-market plans that connect product, commercial, and market‑access priorities into a clear path to adoption.  Track launch performance against defined metrics and help refine future execution.  Develop differentiated plans for public‑sector customers (B2G) and private‑sector customers (B2B).    4. Marketing, brand & demand   Translate complex technical and scientific content into clear, credible messaging tailored to distinct audiences: municipalities, public‑health programs, producers, distributors, and partners.  Execute the marketing mix for your products: content, campaigns, digital, and collateral to build awareness, generate demand, and support the sales cycle.  Help protect and strengthen the brands across market-facing touchpoints.    5. Events & activations   Plan and deliver special activations and commercial events - trade shows, customer engagements, and stakeholder‑facing moments - that generate pipeline and build reputation.  Own the execution details: logistics, budget tracking, materials, delivery, and commercial follow‑through.    6. Enablement & cross‑functional collaboration   Prepare the messaging, tools, and materials the commercial team needs to sell effectively.  Partner across sales, regulatory, technical, and leadership to keep product and marketing activity aligned.  Measure what works across launch and campaign activity, and share insight to drive continuous improvement.    7. Pricing, Financial Modelling & P&L   Contribute to pricing strategies for both biological products and digital platforms.  Support leadership in building financial models and P&L projections for product launches and regional expansion, as well as business cases and investment decisions.  Evaluate unit economics across different business models, including public‑health deployments, software licensing and data‑analytics services and agricultural products for pest monitoring and control.    What you'll bring: Skills, Experience, and Education Requirements  These are the capabilities the role genuinely requires. If you meet most of them and are excited by the mission, we'd like to hear from you.   Experience in product marketing and product management of innovative products.  Experience in an early‑stage or fast‑scaling environment where you helped build process and structure.  Ability to turn complex or technical products into clear, persuasive commercial messaging.  Exposure to go‑to‑market execution and product launches, supporting or coordinating them end to end.  Experience planning and delivering marketing campaigns, events, or activations.  Strong collaboration skills, being comfortable working across commercial, technical, and regulatory teams.  Good commercial judgment and comfort working with market data and insight.  Strong organization and follow‑through, with the ability to manage several workstreams at once.    Education   Bachelor's degree in marketing, business/administration, communications, life sciences, biology, agronomy, biotechnology, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience. Specialization in product management and marketing.  Professional fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish, given the Latam scope.    Key Competencies   Product Strategy Support: Ability to help translate scientific innovation into scalable, market‑ready commercial products.  Data‑Driven Decision Making: Strong analytical skills to support market forecasting, pricing, and business‑case development.  Go‑to‑Market Execution: Ability to coordinate product launches across multiple markets and channels, from planning through post‑launch tracking.  Commercial Acumen: Working understanding of pricing, basic business‑case/margin modeling, and channel development.  Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across R&D, regulatory, marketing, operations, and commercial teams.  Scientific Translation & Communication: Ability to turn complex technical and scientific content into clear, persuasive messaging for diverse audiences (municipalities, public‑health programs, producers, distributors, partners).  Market & Competitive Intelligence: Ability to gather, synthesize, and act on customer, competitor, and market insight across Latam.    Behavioural Requirements   Commitment to, and passion for, the Flyttr mission and values.  Responsive to the needs of an international business working across different time zones, adapting working patterns in‑line with business requirements.  Positive, humble, co‑operative and professional always.  Resilient and persistent in an innovative and constantly changing environment.  Takes full accountability for outcomes, follows through on commitments, and proactively solves problems without waiting for direction.  Moves with urgency and discipline: balances speed with rigor, knowing when to act fast, when to elevate, and when deeper analysis is needed.  Welcomes feedback and learns quickly: is coachable, self‑aware, and open to challenge; actively seeks input and turns lessons into better decisions and stronger execution.  Builds trust across functions: develops strong, credible relationships with leader, colleagues, partners, and customers by being reliable, transparent, and collaborative.  Communicates with clarity and influence: can simplify complex scientific, technical, and commercial topics for different audiences, aligning stakeholders around decisions and action.  Holds a high bar for excellence: consistently produces high‑quality work, uses data to challenge assumptions, and pushes for continuous improvement in both strategy and execution.  Acts with integrity: is honest, principled, and trustworthy; raises concerns early, handles sensitive information responsibly, and does the right thing even when it is difficult.  Values kindness and respect: treats others with empathy, professionalism, and humility, while fostering an environment where people feel valued, heard, and supported.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Além disso, nos esforçamos para fomentar a igualdade de gênero, promover oportunidades iguais e combater a discriminação. Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.    Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo. Por isso, “criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento” é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente. Requisitos obrigatórios:   Experiência comprovada com administração de sistemas operacionais Windows Server e Linux;  Sólido conhecimento em Active Directory, GPO, DNS e DHCP;  Conhecimento prático em ambientes virtualizados com VMware vSphere;  Experiência com soluções corporativas de backup;  Vivência em ambientes de nuvem OCI e/ou Microsoft Azure;  Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de infraestrutura;  Forte entendimento em redes TCP/IP e segurança de rede;  Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes complexos;  Experiência com automação utilizando Shell Script, PowerShell ou Ansible;  Conhecimento em práticas e frameworks de segurança da informação, como ISO 27001 e NIST;  Boa comunicação, organização e documentação técnica. title: [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior
description:
Empresa está contratando [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.  With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.  We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.  Role Overview  The Senior Content Analyst will build and manage CI&T’s North American content operations ecosystem. This hands‑on role oversees CMS governance, content repositories, metadata and taxonomy, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), content lifecycle management, and AI‑enabled workflows. The goal is to make content searchable, reusable, discoverable, and optimized for both search engines and AI‑powered platforms.  Key Responsibilities  Content Operations and CMS   Build and maintain centralized content and proof‑point repositories.  Establish metadata, taxonomy, tagging, naming, and version‑control standards.  Manage content organization, localization, refresh, archiving, and retirement.  Coordinate website publishing and ensure content meets brand, accessibility, metadata, and quality standards.  Improve CMS workflows and resolve publishing or governance issues across teams.    SEO and GEO   Lead North America SEO and GEO governance.  Apply on‑page SEO, structured content, internal linking, metadata, and keyword best practices.  Support structured data, schemas, topic clusters, FAQs, and entity‑based content.  Conduct keyword, competitor, search‑intent, and content‑gap research.  Monitor discoverability and recommend content improvements.    AI‑Enabled Content Operations   Design, test, and maintain AI‑assisted and agentic content workflows.  Use AI for research, drafting, editing, optimization, repurposing, tagging, summarization, and quality assurance.  Build reusable prompts, workflow templates, and human‑review processes.  Evaluate AI‑generated content for accuracy, quality, originality, brand alignment, and source use.  Establish AI governance, safeguards, and documentation.  Track improvements in content quality, speed, reuse, and efficiency.    Performance and Optimization   Measure content performance, freshness, reuse, search visibility, and repository effectiveness.  Identify content to update, consolidate, repurpose, or retire.  Develop reports and dashboards for content operations, SEO/GEO, and AI adoption.  Track metrics such as time to publish, content reuse, search success, AI‑assisted production, and cycle‑time reduction.    Required Qualifications   High‑level English proficiency and the ability to communicate clearly with North American and global teams.  4–6 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, SEO, content management, marketing operations, or a related field.  Experience in B2B, technology, consulting, professional services, or enterprise marketing.  Hands‑on experience with CMS platforms, SEO, content repositories, metadata, taxonomy, and lifecycle management.  Working knowledge of GEO, AI search visibility, structured content, and emerging discovery practices.  Practical experience using generative AI and building multi‑step workflows, automations, agents, or prompt‑based systems.  Strong understanding of content governance, quality assurance, version control, and human review of AI‑generated content.  Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and process‑development skills.  Ability to work independently across teams, regions, and time zones.    Our benefits:   -Health and dental insurance  -Meal and food allowance  -Childcare assistance  -Extended paternity leave  -Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;  -Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);  -Life insurance  -Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);  -Discount club  -Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well‑being  -Pregnancy and responsible parenting course  -Partnerships with online learning platforms  -Language learning platform    And many more!  More details about our benefits here:   At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here. This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve.  If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.  We have a dedicated Health and Well‑being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

CACTUS  provides expert language editing services to help researchers communicate their findings clearly and successfully publish their work. If you have a strong academic background, enjoy engaging with cutting-edge research, and have an eye for improving scientific writing, this opportunity is for you.  As an Editor , you will leverage your subject-matter expertise to evaluate and refine research manuscripts, ensuring scientific accuracy and discipline-specific clarity while enhancing the quality of the language. Your efforts will help researchers around the globe publish cutting-edge research in prestigious journals.  Job Responsibilities  Review and edit manuscripts to improve the clarity, coherence, and readability of scientific content while preserving the authors’ intended meaning. Ensure that subject-specific terminology, conventions, and scientific arguments are accurate, consistent, and appropriate for the target audience. Improve the presentation of complex research findings to enhance their communication and publication readiness. Edit manuscripts such that the final text meets the highest standards of academic writing, is free of unclear, illogical, or unidiomatic sentences. Adhere to job-specific guidelines and format manuscripts according to the target journal when required. Excellent written English and attention to detail. Prior experience in scientific editing or academic publishing is preferred.   Benefits of this Role  Flexibility to decide when you work Receive a predictable volume of work each month Develop an understanding of the finer points of editing and gain access to articles and tips on our learning and discussion platform Get an inside view of research carried out worldwide   About CACTUS  Established in 2002, Cactus Communications is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Informações adicionais:   Modelo de contratação PJ.    Auxílios oferecidos:   Variável atrelada à metas;  Auxílio Saúde (opcional) - para você, cônjuge e dependentes;  Plano Odontológico (opcional) - para você, cônjuge e dependentes;  Ajuda de custo para Alimentação e Refeição - R$1000,00 no cartão Caju;  TotalPass - parceria para contratação de academias, nutricionista e muito mais ao redor do Brasil, para você, cônjuge e dependentes;  Parcerias Educacionais - oferecemos descontos para cursos de pós-graduação em parcerias com universidades: Pacege(USP), PUC-RS, Fundace(USP) e FGV-Campinas ;  Auxílio para estudo de idiomas- 50% custeado pela empresa.    Somos a iSystems! Uma empresa focada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de Inteligência Artificial visando aumentar a eficiência da cadeia industrial. Nós desenvolvemos soluções através da inteligência artificial e de tecnologias exclusivas. Acreditamos que processos industriais inteligentes trazem melhores resultados, tanto para as corporações quanto para a comunidade, simplificam a vida dos empreendedores e colaboradores e, portanto, fazem do mundo um lugar melhor.  Estamos entre as 100 startups brasileiras mais promissoras em inovação e tecnologia.  Somos um time de pessoas empoderadas e colaborativas que, norteadas pelo nosso propósito de tornar o mundo mais eficiente, construímos nossa história a partir da confiança e respeito às diversidades. Aqui, a gente pensa e respira tecnologia e inovação o tempo todo, sempre trabalhando em equipe para criar a melhor solução que beneficie a todos e a todas. Nossa visão é de simplificar como pessoas e dados se relacionam.  Etapas do nosso processo seletivo:  Inscrições;  Avaliação do perfil;  Carta proposta (para contratação).  É importante ressaltar que o processo pode não acontecer necessariamente na ordem apresentada, variando de acordo com a necessidade. title: [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior
description:
Confira a oportunidade para [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions. With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy. We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day. Role Overview The Senior Content Analyst will build and manage CI&T’s North American content operations ecosystem. This hands‑on role oversees CMS governance, content repositories, metadata and taxonomy, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), content lifecycle management, and AI-enabled workflows. The goal is to make content searchable, reusable, discoverable, and optimized for both search engines and AI-powered platforms. Key Responsibilities Content Operations and CMS Build and maintain centralized content and proof‑point repositories. Establish metadata, taxonomy, tagging, naming, and version‑control standards. Manage content organization, localization, refresh, archiving, and retirement. Coordinate website publishing and ensure content meets brand, accessibility, metadata, and quality standards. Improve CMS workflows and resolve publishing or governance issues across teams.  SEO and GEO Lead North America SEO and GEO governance. Apply on‑page SEO, structured content, internal linking, metadata, and keyword best practices. Support structured data, schemas, topic clusters, FAQs, and entity‑based content. Conduct keyword, competitor, search‑intent, and content-gap research. Monitor discoverability and recommend content improvements.  AI-Enabled Content Operations Design, test, and maintain AI‑assisted and agentic content workflows. Use AI for research, drafting, editing, optimization, repurposing, tagging, summarization, and quality assurance. Build reusable prompts, workflow templates, and human‑review processes. Evaluate AI‑generated content for accuracy, quality, originality, brand alignment, and source use. Establish AI governance, safeguards, and documentation. Track improvements in content quality, speed, reuse, and efficiency.  Performance and Optimization Measure content performance, freshness, reuse, search visibility, and repository effectiveness. Identify content to update, consolidate, repurpose, or retire. Develop reports and dashboards for content operations, SEO/GEO, and AI adoption. Track metrics such as time to publish, content reuse, search success, AI‑assisted production, and cycle‑time reduction.  Required Qualifications High‑level English proficiency and the ability to communicate clearly with North American and global teams. 4–6 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, SEO, content management, marketing operations, or a related field. Experience in B2B, technology, consulting, professional services, or enterprise marketing. Hands‑on experience with CMS platforms, SEO, content repositories, metadata, taxonomy, and lifecycle management. Working knowledge of GEO, AI search visibility, structured content, and emerging discovery practices. Practical experience using generative AI and building multi‑step workflows, automations, agents, or prompt‑based systems. Strong understanding of content governance, quality assurance, version control, and human review of AI‑generated content. Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and process‑development skills. Ability to work independently across teams, regions, and time zones.  Our benefits: Health and dental insurance Meal and food allowance Childcare assistance Extended paternity leave Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass; Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR); Life insurance Continuous learning platform (CI&T University); Discount club Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well‑being Pregnancy and responsible parenting course Partnerships with online learning platforms Language learning platform And many more! This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it. title: Sr Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Sr Supply Chain Analyst em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us We are a Team of passionate individuals, developing ground-breaking biological technologies designed to sustainably, and safely control pests that transmit disease, destroy crops and harm livestock. We do this work to improve lives and livelihoods around the world in the face of the growing threats that pests pose to human health and the global food supply. Whilst what we do relates to developing pest control technologies, Flyttr is about people and is in service to people. We are strongly committed to a set of values, principles, and behaviours, and foster a culture of trust, respect, creativity, and accountability. Click here to learn more, and here to read our CEO’s blog about trust and our culture. Purpose of the Job Flyttr is seeking a highly motivated and dedicated Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support the planning, coordination, and optimization of supply chain operations, helping ensure the efficient flow of materials, inventory, and products while contributing to operational excellence and continuous improvement. The right person to join our Supply Chain team will share with us the passion for delivering our mission, the willingness to serve, the endless curiosity about our activities, and the creativity to always pursue the better solution. We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and collaborative professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to driving results through teamwork and innovation. Key Responsibilities Monitor and coordinate the end-to-end flow of materials, products, and information across the supply chain, from procurement through customer delivery. Develop and execute production planning activities based on installed capacity, sales demand, inventory levels, and business priorities. Plan, monitor, and control inventory levels for raw materials, components, supplies, and finished goods, ensuring product availability while minimizing excess inventory and obsolescence. Monitor purchase orders, follow up with suppliers, and coordinate material deliveries to ensure deadlines and agreed service levels are achieved. Analyse demand trends and support the forecasting process to improve supply planning and inventory decisions. Coordinate order fulfilment activities, managing invoicing while monitoring finished goods availability and shipping scheduling to ensure alignment with sales plan. Coordinate domestic and international transportation, shipments, and logistics providers, when applicable. Identify cost reduction opportunities, improve productivity, and support continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain processes. Support the S&OP process by consolidating demand, production, procurement, and logistics information for cross-functional planning. Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor performance and support decision-making. Assist in ERP master data maintenance related to suppliers, materials, inventory, and planning parameters. Collaborate closely with Sales, Procurement, Production, Finance and Logistics teams to ensure effective execution of supply chain activities. Operate in compliance with the company’s Integrated Management System, ensuring adherence to Quality, Environmental, Health & Safety standards, legal requirements, risk mitigation, sustainability, and continuous improvement  Skills, Experience, and Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in production engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, or related fields. 5-8 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Inventory Management, Operations Planning, or related areas. Solid experience in end-to-end Supply Chain processes, with strong hands-on experience in planning and operational execution. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, TOTVS, or similar, including practical knowledge of planning parameters, master data, purchasing, inventory, and production processes. Experience with inventory management and replenishment processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to analyse complex information, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical actions. Understanding of S&OP and cross-functional planning processes. Proficiency in Power BI or similar BI tools, including the ability to develop, maintain, and interpret dashboards and performance indicators. Advanced Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies. Advanced English, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional and cross-functional environments.  Behavioural Requirements Commitment to and passion for the Flyttr mission. Demonstrated commitment to focusing on organizational needs and setting high standards to ensure quality is maintained. Positive, co-operative, and professional always. Excellent organizational and planning abilities. Attention to detail. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Service and team oriented. Flexible and accommodating in the face of changing requirements. Strong ownership and accountability.  Operate in compliance with the company’s Integrated Management System, ensuring adherence to Quality, Environmental, Health & Safety standards, legal requirements, risk mitigation, sustainability, and continuous improvement. Flyttr is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by Brazilian law.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista Suporte | Júnior LATAM (13327)
description:

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo  A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.  Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.  Conheça + em nosso site:  Qual a missão do Cargo?   Prestar suporte técnico aos nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções com empatia e proatividade, garantindo que eles tenham a melhor experiência possível ao utilizarem nossos produtos. Essa pessoa será responsável por investigar problemas técnicos, orientar usuários e colaborar com times internos para resolver desafios de complexidades variadas.  Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?    Entender e manter-se atualizado sobre as funcionalidades mais recentes dos nossos produtos, suas dependências, a pilha de tecnologia subjacente e seu impacto operacional;  Realizar atendimentos via Zendesk e, ocasionalmente, por videochamada garantindo o cumprimento dos Acordos de Nível de Serviço (SLA) definidos, realizando investigações, diagnósticos e resolução de incidentes, problemas e dúvidas relacionados aos nossos produtos e/ou serviços, colaborando com a continuidade e disponibilidade;  Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares como, customer success, engenharia de produto e consultoria; * Elaborar, revisar e aperfeiçoar documentações técnicas; * Analisar e interpretar logs de infraestrutura;  Analisar e debbugar códigos;  Atuar como ponte de comunicação entre os times de suporte e engenharia, mediando e escalando suas necessidades de forma clara e objetiva para a sustentação da plataforma, priorizando atendimentos e buscando resoluções criativas e eficazes;  Participar de reuniões e encontros da área e da empresa, mesmo que online;  Analisar e aprimorar processos de suporte, identificando obstáculos e agindo proativamente para otimizar a experiência dos nossos clientes;  Ser parceiro dos nossos clientes, buscando entender suas necessidades e oferecendo o melhor suporte possível.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?    Espanhol (atuará com clientes Latam)  Senso de priorização e excelente habilidade de comunicação (oral e escrita) para transmitir informações de forma clara e objetiva para diferentes interlocutores;  Conhecimento básico em requisições HTTP (Montar chamadas, executá-las, identificar seus métodos, conhecer os status code, etc);  Capacidade de leitura e análise de códigos e dashboards de saúde dos serviços (Ex.: Logs diversos, Chrome Dev Tools, JSON, Grafana, Kibana, etc);  Conhecimento de ferramentas de testes de APIs (Ex.: Postman, cURL e SoapUI);  Sólidos conhecimentos sobre APIs e integrações entre sistemas;  Experiência em análise e debugging de código (JavaScript e/ou Java);  Conhecimento intermediário em SQL e estruturação de consultas;  Habilidade em documentar bugs, exceções e comportamentos inesperados adaptando a públicos diversos;  Formação completa ou em curso em áreas de tecnologia ou correlatas.    Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?    Experiência relevante em suporte técnico e atendimento ao cliente em plataforma Saas  Conhecimentos práticos em fundamentos ITIL e Acordos de Nível de Serviço (SLA), incluindo conceitos de gerenciamento de incidentes, problemas e requisições de serviço, adotando melhores práticas e procedimentos específicos para cada tipo de chamado, visando a eficiência e a qualidade do suporte;  Conhecimento em Apache Camel, com foco em análise e troubleshooting de integrações.  Necessário perfil investigativo e habilidade para interpretar a documentação oficial, compreendendo a configuração e interação entre componentes e parâmetros da plataforma.    Aqui você vai encontrar:    Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.      Temos#WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.    Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)   Suas experiências são compatíveis?    Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos eambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão émapearos diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)    *Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Buscamos um profissional com experiência em varejo, preferencialmente em supermercados ou atacarejos, que tenha perfil analítico e conhecimento de rotina de estoque, inventários, giro de produtos, controle de validade e prevenção de perdas.  A posição terá como foco a análise e prevenção de perdas operacionais, utilizando informações de estoque, sistema, giro e validade para identificar riscos, divergências e oportunidades de melhoria antes que as perdas aconteçam.  Importante: esta não é uma posição de segurança patrimonial ou vigilância. O foco é controle de estoque, análise de indicadores, processos e prevenção de perdas no ambiente de varejo/atacarejo.  Principais atividades   Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de estoque e perdas da operação;  Monitorar perdas relacionadas a vencimentos, avarias, quebras e divergências de estoque;  Acompanhar produtos com risco de vencimento, considerando validade, estoque e giro;  Analisar divergências entre estoque físico e sistêmico;  Acompanhar inventários e apoiar na identificação e tratativa das divergências;  Realizar controles relacionados à validade e armazenamento adequado dos produtos;  Verificar o cumprimento do sistema PEPS/FIFO;  Analisar movimentações de estoque, giro e comportamento dos produtos;  Identificar causas de perdas e propor ações preventivas e corretivas;  Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Operação, Estoque, Recebimento e Compras;  Criar, atualizar e acompanhar controles e indicadores de estoque e perdas;  Propor melhorias nos processos com o objetivo de reduzir perdas e aumentar a eficiência operacional;  Acompanhar produtos de diferentes categorias, incluindo alimentos, perecíveis e produtos de alto giro.    Requisitos  Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Processos ou áreas correlatas;  Experiência com controle de estoque no varejo, preferencialmente em supermercados ou atacarejos;  Vivência com inventários, controle de validade, giro de produtos e análise de divergências;  Conhecimento em Excel e facilidade para trabalhar com planilhas, controles e indicadores;  Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão/ERP;  Conhecimento de processos de estoque e armazenagem no segmento de varejo;  Perfil analítico, organizado, proativo e orientado para identificação e solução de problemas;  Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuar em parceria com diferentes áreas da operação. Aqui todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, queremos ser uma empresa cada vez mais plural e diversa!
